existing_features.title: Fix the CustomMapView component so that zooming in does not cause the map to fail or crash. Ensure that tile fetching, Web Mercator projection math, marker positioning, and viewport bounds recalculation all remain stable and correct at any zoom level within the allowed min/max range. The map must remain interactive and render correctly after zoom in, zoom out, and reset operations.

projectName: Fix map zoom failure in CustomMapView
